Use case: compositing. Asset: transparent full-canvas 1672x941 (16:9) doorway OVERLAY for a layered Unity room.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: act1 Forward doorway layer, it establishes exact canvas framing, alpha placement, doorway scale, perspective and entrance location. Image2 is the NEW ACT2 WALL BACKDROP it must be seamlessly laid on top of. Image3 is the installed Warrior ink reference, image4 the original style drawing. Output ONLY the doorway patch on true transparency, all other canvas area fully transparent; same full canvas dimensions and no recentering/cropping. No room-wide wall/floor painting.
Repaint image1's doorway so its stone color, broad shape language, illumination and border join naturally into image2. Front doorway faces camera straight on, at x42%-58%, tip y23%, threshold y61.5% (coordinates downward from top). Its total opaque bounds must stay x41.7%-58.6%, y19%-62%, exactly image1. Rear wall-floor threshold is level with the new wall image2. Broad plain pointed arch stones, black passage inside.
The arch's cavity is a large OPAQUE nearly black negative-space entrance (do NOT make the cavity transparent). Only the surrounding unused canvas is transparent. The outer patch follows the minimal arch/wall contours, no rectangular light wall patch visible, no floating arch icon, no standalone ground shadow. Do not add new pillars/torches/decorations or modify other rooms. Muted blue-gray stones with cool cyan side light from image2; not white/bright ice.
Match image2's large connected solid ink blacks and selective bold contours, very few large stone blocks, quiet surfaces. No tiny cracks/chips, no granular faceting, no UI, arrows or text. This is an architectural opening within that room, not an object pasted in front.
